source_policy.rule: Stock references inform high-level composition/camera/light vocabulary only; never claim the stock asset as our original work.

global_hymn_rules.camera_motion_default: locked tripod or extremely slow push/pan
global_hymn_rules.lyric_safe_zone: center and lower third low-detail with moderate/dark contrast

WATERFALL.framing: wide, waterfall on left/right third, dark rock/forest lyric-safe center-lower area
WATERFALL.motion: steady downward water + gentle mist + subtle foliage

RIVER_STREAM.framing: wide low river-bank view with diagonal water path and quiet lyric-safe bank
RIVER_STREAM.camera: locked or extremely slow lateral pan
RIVER_STREAM.motion: steady flow + small ripples + subtle reflection drift

OCEAN_WAVES.framing: wide shoreline, horizon upper third, darker lower center for lyrics
OCEAN_WAVES.motion: slow periodic waves approach/recede + gentle foam

RAIN_WINDOW.framing: medium-wide interior window, rainy glass foreground, soft exterior, darker lower center
RAIN_WINDOW.motion: slow droplets down glass + soft distant rain

FIREPLACE.framing: medium-wide off-center fireplace with dark surrounding lyric area
FIREPLACE.motion: restrained flame flicker + occasional small embers

WIND_FOREST_FIELD.framing: wide field/forest edge with layered depth and calm lyric area
WIND_FOREST_FIELD.motion: low-frequency grass/tree sway with phase offsets

SUNRISE.framing: wide landscape, sun off-center, darker foreground lyric area
SUNRISE.motion: very slow light rise + subtle cloud drift

SUNSET.framing: wide horizon, sun off-center, dark lower foreground
SUNSET.motion: very slow light fall + cloud drift

BIRDS_WIDE.framing: very wide sky/landscape, tiny distant birds, lyric area mostly empty
BIRDS_WIDE.motion: few distant birds cross slowly with natural wingbeats

STORM_TO_CLEAR.framing: wide landscape, layered clouds, dark foreground lyric area
STORM_TO_CLEAR.motion: rain/cloud motion gradually reduces as distant opening brightens

flow_output.veo_rule: Only an image that passes current Gemini Eye image QC plus OpenAI crosscheck may become a Veo first-frame seed.
